findings.finding: Parent cues, child bullets, topic headings, checkboxes and exam badges remain visually distinct. Original explanation panels have readable text, clear boundaries and a visible eye/disclosure label. No visible horizontal clipping or title/control collision in reviewed states.

Headings, cues, buttons and original text wrap inside the available width. The toolbar is in normal document flow on mobile, leaving the reading area unobstructed. Nested bullets remain distinguishable.

Reviewed Greek/set symbols, inequality, arrows and multiplication glyphs render without missing-character boxes. Nyquist/Shannon formulas and a long Node code example remain readable. Long code wraps within cue and original-explanation panels without truncation.
After hash-navigation scrolling settles, the desktop target heading appears below the sticky toolbar. The mobile target appears without toolbar overlap.

Final homepage displays all sixteen cards. Desktop uses two columns; 390px mobile uses one column. Long course names and the overview total wrap without clipping; guidance controls and footer remain readable.
